common_intent_requirements.text: 把装着半杯水的透明玻璃杯慢慢倾斜一点
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把装着半杯水的透明玻璃杯慢慢倾斜一点
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: a transparent drinking glass holding about half a glass of water. A level tabletop and an upright background edge provide clear orientation references. A hand slowly tilts the glass by a small amount, keeping the rim high enough to retain the water.
The hand then holds the glass still in its tilted position.
Finish on the tilted glass held steady with all of its water retained.

common_intent_requirements.text: 拍清杯子和水面的变化
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 拍清杯子和水面的变化
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: Keep the whole glass, the rim and the water boundary readable throughout.

physics_checks.criterion: 杯子停止倾斜并保持后，自由液面总体趋于重力下的水平，而不会刚性粘随杯口倾斜。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 能区分杯口倾斜方向、水面方向及静置后的状态。
fail_examples: 静置后液面仍像固体一样始终平行于倾斜杯口
液体贴在杯壁上形成没有支撑的整体斜块
倾杯时水量无流出却大量消失
not_required: 运动中允许水面晃动、弯曲和壁面润湿
不要求像素级水平或完全没有波纹

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
